title: Inventory Price Ranking
description: An e-commerce platform stores its product catalog prices in a Binary Search Tree (BST). Management wants to find the k-th lowest product price in the catalog. Given the root of the BST and an integer k, write a function to return the k-th smallest price in the catalog.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is k.
input_format: The root of the BST and an integer k.
output_format: An integer representing the k-th smallest price value.

examples.explanation: The sorted prices are 1, 2, 3, 4. The 1st smallest price is 1.
The sorted prices are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. The 3rd smallest price is 3.
The sorted prices are 5, 10, 15. The 2nd smallest price is 10.
